_comment: Template for `pyuvimage fit --config this-file.json`. Every key is a `pyuvimage fit` flag without the leading dashes, set to its default; keys beginning with an underscore are ignored, so they can be used for notes. Delete the lines you do not want to set -- a key that is present is applied, even at its default. Anything also given on the command line wins, so a saved configuration can be re-run with one value changed. docs/parameters.md explains what each one does.
_dataset: the dataset directory or .npz, and the field of view in arcsec. Both may also be given on the command line; --fov is required one way or the other.
_geometry: model mesh and where the image is centred. image-centre takes [x, y] in arcsec in image axes (+x right, +y up) or "auto"; no escaping is needed for a negative value here, unlike on the command line.
_prior: the source prior and its hyperparameters. "lambda" is --lambda (the regularisation strength); "scale" is the kernel correlation length.
_criterion: how the hyperparameters are chosen, and the positivity constraint.
_engine: transform backend, inversion formalism and the streaming load. "streaming" takes true, false or "auto" (the default: stream whenever it applies).
_products: what is written alongside the model image.
_points: analytic point components. "point" takes a list of [x, y] positions in arcsec, image axes, and implies point-sources with auto-detection off.
